transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: I'm having difficulty in breathing. I'm having fever since 2 days.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, did you take any medicines?

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, let me check your temperature. It looks like you have 101 degrees of fever. Let me check your mouth. Ah, it has a mild redness. Okay, you continue this paracetamol and antibiotics for 2 days. Other 2 days if the fever persists again beyond 101 degrees Celsius, then please come for a visit again. We will, I'll write for a blood test like CBC, CBP, okay? We'll do a blood test, and based on the reports we can go for further treatment.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Continue taking rest for 2 days at least and make sure to wear a mask when you go outside.

summary.chief_complaint: Difficulty breathing and fever for 2 days.
summary.consultation_overview: Patient presented with a 2-day history of fever and difficulty breathing. Doctor recorded a temperature of 101 degrees and noted mild oral redness upon examination. The doctor advised continuing paracetamol, starting antibiotics for 2 days, taking rest, and wearing a mask outside. A follow-up with blood tests (CBC, CBP) was recommended if the fever persists.
summary.history_of_present_illness: Patient has been experiencing fever and difficulty breathing for the past 2 days. Took paracetamol prior to consultation.
investigations: Blood test (CBC, CBP) - advised if fever persists
summary.assessment: Fever with mild oral redness and respiratory difficulty.
summary.treatment_plan: Continue paracetamol and take antibiotics for 2 days. Take rest for at least 2 days and wear a mask when going outside. If fever persists beyond 2 days or above 101 degrees, follow up for blood tests (CBC, CBP).
advice: Wear a mask when going outside
summary.follow_up: Return for a follow-up visit and blood tests (CBC, CBP) if fever persists beyond 101 degrees after 2 days.
